facts.text: The booklet's diagrams are written in Mermaid and render in viewers that support Mermaid, including GitHub, Obsidian, Visual Studio Code with a Mermaid extension, and most documentation generators.
facts.quote: Diagrams are written in Mermaid. They render in viewers that support it (GitHub, Obsidian, Visual Studio Code with a Mermaid extension, and most documentation generators)

facts.text: Viewers that do not support Mermaid display the booklet's diagram source as text rather than rendering the diagrams.
facts.quote: in other viewers the diagram source appears as text.
